render_dot_markdown: render a .in.md file containing DOT graph code blocks into a .md file with embedded SVG images
convert_dot_to_svg: convert DOT graph code blocks in a markdown file to SVG images using the dot command
generate_markdown_with_images: generate a markdown file with centered image tags replacing DOT graph code blocks
review_render_script: review the render.py script that processes DOT graphs in markdown files and outputs SVG images
run_render_pipeline: run the render script on a .in.md file to produce a .md file with rendered DOT diagrams
